name: Jory Fenn
description: Ink-stained cuffs, a satchel strap worn shiny. Can't keep still.

visits.greeting: Hello — sorry — is this where you ask? For books? Of course it is. Sorry.

request.text: The Patient Mind, please. My examination's in three days and nothing will stay in my head.

byTrust.2: Spring paper. Red ink across the top. Harrow's desk drawer.

purpose.1: Revising. Dates, mostly, and the order of the Board's charters, which nobody needs, but there it is.
purpose.2: Revising. I failed the spring paper, so this one has to — it just has to go well.

knowledge.1: Memory charms? It's called The Patient Mind. I assume it's patient. And about minds. Sorry.
knowledge.2: Remembering things. And — I've heard there's a page about the other way round. Forgetting.

source.1: Everyone at the Academy knows it. Well. Everyone who's failed something.

experience.1: Little ones. A charm for finding my pen. It mostly works.
experience.3: I put a fixing charm on my marks once, just to see. I undid it. I did undo it.

questions.text: What happened with the spring paper?

answers.1: Nothing. Why? Nothing happened with it.
answers.2: I failed it. Harrow marked it. It's in his drawer with all the red on it, and I think about it every night.
answers.3: I failed it, and I've thought about him forgetting it more than I've thought about the dates. That's the truth.

questions.text: One page in that book is about making someone forget. Had you heard?

answers.1: No! I mean — everyone's heard. Doesn't mean anyone would.
answers.2: I'd heard. I've thought about it. I'm telling you because I don't want to.

lent.line: Thank you — thank you. I'll bring it back early. I always bring things back early.

alternative.line: Oh. Will it — will it help? All right. All right, I'll trust you. I think.

offerRefused.line: Sorry — I don't think that's — I really need the memory one.

declined.line: Right. No. That's fine. That's — fine.

walkedOut.line: I have to go, I'm sorry, I've revision —

mixedMisuse.headline: Examiner mislays the spring results
mixedMisuse.text: Mr T. Harrow of the Academy reports that he cannot recall the spring examination results, and that his notes on them are "unaccountably blank". The paper will be re-sat.

good.text: It worked! I mean — I worked. The book helped. I remembered all of it. Well. Most of it.

unhelpful.text: It was a nice book. It didn't help with the dates. I'm not blaming you. I'm blaming the dates.

harmMisuse.text: Did you hear? Someone's been altering marks in the Academy ledgers. Very neat work, apparently. They're checking every page.

greeting.text: Have you seen the paper? About Harrow? No, don't — never mind. Hello.
Hello again. Sorry. I haven't really slept.

request.text: Something to help me sleep. I can't stop going over it. Dates, charters, dates.

readThoughts.default: Twelfth charter, thirteenth charter, fourteenth. Three in the morning.

purpose.1: Sleep. Just sleep. Ordinary sleep. Is that a thing you have?
purpose.2: If I sleep through the night I'll be fine. If I don't I'll go in there and forget my own name.

knowledge.1: Something gentle? I don't want to be knocked out. I have to wake up for it.

experience.1: I tried counting. I got to four thousand.

questions.text: When did you last sleep a night through?

answers.2: Since the spring results. Honestly. Since then.

lent.line: Thank you. Sleep. I'll sleep. Good.

offerRefused.line: I — sorry, I don't think that's for sleeping.

sleep-neighbours.text: I slept. Right through it. The bell, my landlady, the examination. They let me sit it late, in a corridor. I don't know how it went.

good.text: I slept. Eight hours. I didn't know people did that.

request.text: Anything on memory. Anything at all.

readThoughts.default: Spring paper. Red ink. Two days left.

questions.text: Is this still about the spring paper?

answers.2: It's always about the spring paper.

mixedMisuse.headline: Examiner mislays the spring results
mixedMisuse.text: Mr T. Harrow of the Academy reports that he cannot recall the spring examination results, and that his notes on them are "unaccountably blank". The paper will be re-sat.

harmMisuse.text: Did you hear? Someone's been altering marks in the Academy ledgers. Very neat work, apparently. They're checking every page.

visits.greeting: They marked the corridor paper. I passed. Barely. I'm never sleeping again.

request.text: Tricks for the Parlour? I want something fun, for once. Something that isn't for anything.

readThoughts.default: Coins behind ears. My sister laughing.

purpose.2: Fun. My sister's birthday. She thinks I'm boring.

answers.2: Bess. She's nine. She'll be unbearable if I get the coin trick wrong.

lent.line: Thank you. Really. For all of it.

alternative.line: Is it fun? It had better be fun.

declined.line: That's fair. I'd decline me too.

visits.greeting: I passed. I think I passed because Harrow forgot. I don't know if that was me.

request.text: Tricks for the Parlour? I want something fun, for once. Something that isn't for anything.

readThoughts.default: Harrow's blank notes. My name not in them.

purpose.2: Fun. Coins behind ears. My sister's birthday.
purpose.3: Something that doesn't matter. I'd like something that doesn't matter.

questions.text: Do you think it was you?

answers.2: I don't know. I never said the words. I thought about it so hard, though.
answers.3: I read the page. I didn't say it. I'll never know, will I.

lent.line: Thank you. Really. For all of it.

alternative.line: Is it fun? It had better be fun.

declined.line: That's fair. I'd decline me too.

visits.greeting: I passed. On my own. I wanted you to know.

request.text: Tricks for the Parlour? I want something fun, for once. Something that isn't for anything.

readThoughts.default: My name on the pass list. Third from the top.

purpose.2: Fun. Coins behind ears. My sister's birthday.

questions.text: Where were you on the list?

answers.2: Third. Third! I've never been third at anything.

lent.line: Thank you. Really. For all of it.

alternative.line: Is it fun? It had better be fun.

declined.line: That's fair. I'd decline me too.
